title: [Audit] Security configuration changes
description: Raw security_config_change payloads, one row per event, newest first — API key invalidation, user profile writes, role and privilege edits. The field is a JSON string, shown verbatim. client.ip is not kept: Elasticsearch does not record it on security config events. An Identity shown as “_4KEO… · Cloud API key” is an organization-level Elastic Cloud API key: the audit stream records it only by its opaque 20-character id, shown here by its first five characters; it has no name and no owner email.
esql: FROM logs-elastic_cloud.serverless_audit.otel-default | WHERE attributes.elasticsearch.audit.security_config_change IS NOT NULL | EVAL actor = COALESCE(attributes.user.email, attributes.api_key.name, attributes.user.name, "<anonymous>") | KEEP @timestamp, actor, attributes.event.action, attributes.elasticsearch.audit.security_config_change | SORT @timestamp DESC | EVAL actor = CASE((LENGTH(actor) == 20 AND actor RLIKE "[-_A-Za-z0-9]{20}" AND NOT actor RLIKE "[0-9]{20}"), CONCAT(LEFT(actor, 5), "… · Cloud API key"), actor) | RENAME @timestamp AS Time, actor AS Identity, attributes.event.action AS Action, attributes.elasticsearch.audit.security_config_change AS Change
